3532-5078-5402-8176.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
3532-5078-5402-8176.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Captain Storm triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Captain Storm.
Repeat.

1669-3234-3293-6495.easyPrerequisites: You control a Plains or have a Plains in your graveyard.
1669-3234-3293-6495.description:
Activate Thaumatog by sacrificing a land.
Repeat step 1 until you control no lands.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing World Shaper.
When World Shaper dies, it triggers, return all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter, Emeria Shepherd triggers that many times.
Resolve an Emeria Shepherd trigger that was triggered by a Plains, returning World Shaper from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve all remaining Emeria Shepherd triggers.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat
1669-3234-3293-6495.notes:
You can return all nonland permanents in your graveyard and library to the battlefield if you control there are two or more Plains between your graveyard, library and battlefield. To do this, have all triggers from Emeria Shepherd target desired permanents. Then, resolve the Plains triggers first to return those cards to the battlefield, causing all other triggers to fizzle on the stack.
If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

1671-5414-6871-7115--44.description:
Cast the artifact by paying {0}.
Toph, Hardheaded Teacher triggers, earthbending Simic Growth Chamber.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Troubled Healer by sacrificing Simic Growth Chamber.
When Simic Growth Chamber dies, Toph, Hardheaded Teach triggers, returning Simic Growth Chamber from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Simic Growth Chamber enters, it triggers, returning the artifact cast in step 1 from the battlefield to your hand, as it's a land due to Toph, the First Metalbender.
Resolve the Troubled Healer ability
Repeat.

1174-6628-7857.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand that enters the battlefield untapped and can tap to produce at least {1}.
You control a mana-producing land.
1174-6628-7857.description:
Activate PuPu UFO by tapping it, putting a land from your hand onto the battlefield.
When the land enters the battlefield, Elven Raft-Steerer  triggers, untapping PuPu UFO.
Activate the land and another land by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Oboro Breezecaller by paying {2} and returning a land from the battlefield to your hand, untapping another land.
Repeat.

2021-2060-7741-7803.notablePrerequisites: Brad Boimler has been tapped this turn.
2021-2060-7741-7803.description:
Activate Simic Ascendancy by paying {1}{G}{U}, putting four +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Simic Ascendancy triggers, putting growth counters on it.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's second ability by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{G}{U}.
Repeat.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Simic Ascendancy triggers, causing you to win the game.

372-5694-7487.notablePrerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Eldrazi Confluence exiled by Abdel Adrian.
372-5694-7487.description:
Cast Eldrazi Confluence by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Zealous Lorecaster and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Zealous Lorecaster trigger.
Resolve the Zealous Lorecaster trigger, returning Eldrazi Confluence from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Eldrazi Confluence.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Zealous Lorecaster and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

333-5147-7424.notablePrerequisites: Changing Loyalty attached to Shepherd of the Cosmos.
333-5147-7424.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Shepherd of the Cosmos.
When Shepherd of the Cosmos dies, Changing Loyalty triggers, returning Shepherd of the Cosmos from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Shepherd of the Cosmos enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Changing Loyalty from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Shepherd of the Cosmos.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability
Repeat.

140-1824-4549.easyPrerequisites: You have not completed, or are venturing in, Tomb of Annihilation.
140-1824-4549.notablePrerequisites: You've lost 2 or more life this turn.
140-1824-4549.description:
Activate Rowan by tapping it.
Cast Acererak by paying {B}.
When Acererak enters, its first ability triggers.
Holding priority, activate Relic of Legends' second ability by tapping Acererak, adding {B}.
Resolve the Acererak trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand, and venturing into Lost Mine of Phandelver.
Repeat from step 2.

206-465-803-3742-4251.description:
Declare Phantom Steed and Godo as attackers, triggering each of their second abilities.
Resolve the Godo trigger, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Phantom Steed trigger, creating a token copy of Wormfang Drake.
When the token Wormfang Drake enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Godo.
At the end of your combat phase, Phantom Steed triggers, causing you to sacrifice the Wormfang Drake token.
When the token Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Godo from exile to the battlefield.
When Godo enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, allowing you to search your library for an Equipment card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

891-4775-5231.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Boonweaver Giant
When Boonweaver Giant dies, Necrogen Communion triggers, returning Boonweaver Giant from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Boonweaver Giant enters, it triggers, returning Necrogen Communion from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Boonweaver Giant.
Repeat.

1267-7334.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1267-7334.description:
Declare The Neutrinos as an attacker, triggering its second ability, blinking Medomai and causing it to enter tapped and attacking.
Deal combat damage using Medomai, triggering its ability, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

628-2438-7214.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Glen Elendra Guardian.
When Glen Elendra Guardian dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability
Repeat.

3525-4028-4474.description:
Activate Zhur-Taa Druid by tapping it, adding {U}.
Zhur-Taa Druid triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Zhur-Taa Druid.
Repeat.

4050-5078-6650-7028.easyPrerequisites: The Lunar Whale has attacked this turn.
4050-5078-6650-7028.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield onto the top of your library.
Wan Shi Tong's second ability triggers, creating two 1/1 Spirit creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a Spirit, adding {1}.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Repeat.

5073-5220-5933-6900.description:
Activate Tinder Wall by sacrificing it.
When Tinder Wall dies, Mortuary and Popular Egotist trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Tinder Wall from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Popular Egotist trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Cast Tinder Wall from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more loyalty counters on it

826-4094-4508-5880.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Amoeboid Changeling by tapping it, causing Magmaw to gain all creature types until end of turn.
Activate Magmaw by paying {1} and sacrificing another nonland permanent, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat from step 3.

4613-4968-5872-6843.description:
Activate Taii Wakeen by paying {1} and tapping it, increasing the amount of damage sources you control deal this turn by one.
Activate Anti-Venom using Deathbringer Thoctar's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, targeting itself and putting two +1/+1 counters on it due to its replacement effect and Taii Wakeen.
Activate Anti-Venom using Deathbringer Thoctar's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat from step 2.

851-5437-5742-5743.description:
Activate Prognostic Sphinx by discarding Gilded Assault Cart.
Mary Read and Anne Bonny triggers, creating two tapped Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Prognostic Sphinx ability.
Activate Gilded Assault Cart by sacrificing two Treasures, returning Gilded Assault Cart from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

222-527-1115-5256.notablePrerequisites:
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
You control a Saproling.
222-527-1115-5256.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Altar of Dementia twice by sacrificing Slimefoot and Squee and Selvala.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

2577-5670-5916.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Gravecrawler, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Moonstone Eulogist's last ability triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and put a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Repeat.

2452-2842-3249-5670--56.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
2452-2842-3249-5670--56.description:
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast a Zombie from your graveyard this turn.
Cast the Zombie from your graveyard by paying {0} due to Rooftop Storm.
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing the Zombie.
When the Zombie dies, Blood Artist triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and an opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

1270-2523-4711.notablePrerequisites:
Ojer Taq does not have summoning sickness.
You have at least three opponents.
1270-2523-4711.description:
Declare Ojer Taq as an attacker.
Ojer Taq's myriad ability triggers, creating three token copies of Ojer Taq that are tapped and attacking each opponent.
Put all Ojer Taq tokens into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Ojer Taq tokens die, Ratadrabik of Urborg triggers that many times.
Resolve the first trigger, creating a number of nonlegendary token copies of Ojer Taq equal to 3^(the number of Ojer Taqs you control) that are 2/2 Zombies.
Repeat step 5 for each remaining trigger.

185-3075-4293-4664.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three experience counters.
185-3075-4293-4664.description:
Cast Apex of Power by paying at most {4}{R}{R}{R}.
If you have fewer than ten experience counters, Mizzix of the Izmagnus triggers, causing you to get an experience counter.
Resolve Apex of Power, exiling the top seven cards of your library with the ability to cast them until end of turn, and adding either ten {U} or ten {R}.
Cast Mystic Retrieval by paying {U}, returning Apex of Power from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Mystic Retrieval from your graveyard for its flashback cost by paying {R}, returning Runic Repetition from your graveyard to your hand and exiling Mystic Retrieval.
Cast Runic Repetition by paying {U}, returning Mystic Retrieval from exile to your hand.
Repeat.

586-4316-5220-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Priest of Gix on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to Priest of Gix's power.
Cast Priest of Gix from the top of your library by paying {2}{B}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Ioreth of the Healing House

1432-2719.notablePrerequisites:
All permanents do not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one additional legendary creature.
1432-2719.description:
Activate Sakashima's second ability by tapping it, untapping Ioreth and another legendary creature you control.
Activate Ioreth's second ability by tapping it, untapping Sakashima and another legendary creature you control.
Repeat.

1379-1651-3685-4497-5051.notablePrerequisites: Slobad does not have summoning sickness.
1379-1651-3685-4497-5051.description:
Activate Slobad by tapping it and sacrificing Spine of Ish Sah, adding {7} that can only be spent to cast artifact spells or to activate abilities of artifacts.
Spine of Ish Sah leaves the battlefield, returning itself from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Spine of Ish Sah by paying {7}.
Traxos triggers, untapping itself.
Spine of Ish Sah enters the battlefield, destroying target permanent.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping Traxos and Spine of Ish Sah, untapping Slobad.
Repeat.
